title: Animated Steel Armour

{{External|rs}}{{otheruses|the armour that can be animated in the [[Warriors' Guild]]|the ones found in [[Tarn's Lair]]|Animated steel armour (Tarn's Lair)}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Animated Steel Armour |image = [[File:Animated Steel Armour.png|120px]] |release = [[13 June]] [[2006]] |update = Warriors' Guild |members = Yes |combat = 46 |size = 1 |examine = Animated steel armour. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 5 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |hitpoints = 40 |att = 40 |str = 40 |def = 40 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 4 |strbns = 5 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 50 |dslash = 25 |dcrush = 19 |dmagic = 400 |dlight = 400 |dstandard = 400 |dheavy = 400 |elementalweaknesstype = Earth |elementalweaknesspercent = 30 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |immunecannon = no |immunethrall = yes |immuneburn = Strong |id = 2452 |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} '''Animated steel armour''' is a player-created foe encountered at the [[Warriors' Guild]]. To summon one, players must use a [[steel platebody]], [[steel platelegs]], and a [[steel full helm]] on the [[magical animator]]. The steel animated armour isn't commonly used for two reasons: helms will occasionally be lost, and higher variants yield better [[Warrior guild token|tokens]] per hour. Despite being one of the weakest armour types, players should still bring a few pieces of food. If players do decide to fight the steel armour, it is suggested to also carry a few steel full helms to replace the ones that get destroyed. If possible, players should fight animated armour made of [[Animated Black Armour|black]] or higher instead, due to the fact that they will not lose any parts. Like all other animated armour variants, it is immune to [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] attacks. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, the armour is effectively immune to [[burn]], which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage. It is also immune to [[poison]] and [[venom]]. ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|kills=12886}} ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Warrior guild token|quantity=15|rarity=Always|raritynotes=The amount of tokens dropped is increased to 30 after unlocking the [[easy Combat Achievements]] rewards tier, or 45 after unlocking the [[medium Combat Achievements]] rewards tier.|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist}} ===Armour=== ''There is a possibility of losing steel full helms while fighting this animated monster.'' {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Steel full helm|quantity=1|rarity=9/10}} {{DropsLine|name=Steel platebody|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Steel platelegs|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = The NPC now has a 30% elemental weakness to [[earth spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 24 August 2017 |update = Remember username, tooltips, and Wilderness Wars! |change = Animated suits of armour within the Warriors' Guild will no longer retreat. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 13 June –
